relationships.evidence_quote: Our data conclusively show that SNI induced NLRP3/NLRC4 inflammasome activation and neuronal pyroptosis in the rat spinal cord.

relationships.subject: GSDMD-N
relationships.evidence_quote: Results revealed that GSDMD-N co-localized exclusively with NeuN in the spinal cord dorsal horn, but not with Iba-1 or GFAP (Figure 5).

key_findings: Transcriptomic analysis of SNI rat dorsal horn found 11 upregulated pyroptosis-related genes, with Nlrc4 and Nlrp3 highest and Casp1 as PPI hub.
NLRP3/NLRC4, ASC, cleaved caspase-1, GSDMD-N, IL-1β and IL-18 rose after SNI; GSDMD-N localized to neurons, not microglia or astrocytes.
